positions.title: Research and Development  Expert
positions.description: Exercise cutting edge technology in order to assimilate them into the business processes of the employer. I was tasked with the research, development and recommendation of emerging technologies such as Snappmx and Windev to create dynamic and user friendly applications running on MySQL or DB2 relational database systems.

honors.title: Microsoft Imagine Cup Semi-Finalist

projects.title: FINAL EXAM SCHEDULE GENERATOR
projects.description: AEorion TTG is a schedule optimization application which was prototyped in MATLAB and developed with C# and Microsoft Visual Studio. The application uses a stochastic optimization algorithm to produce optimal exam schedules.

projects.title: G-Mox
projects.description: Designed and implemented a GPS tracking Solution (G-Mox).
